Does your child have a history of congenital heart defects, or have they recently experienced poor feeding or excessive sweating during feeds? REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Atrial Septal Defect (ASD) presenting with congestive heart failure. The enlarged cardiac silhouette and echocardiogram confirming a left-to-right shunt explain the rapid breathing, leg swelling, and poor appetite. Given the confirmed structural defect and heart failure symptoms, no further diagnostic testing is required.
